test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The simple interest on Rs. 10,000 for 6 months at the rate of 5 paisa per rupee per month is:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 10,000

Time (T) = 6 months = 0.5 years

Rate (R) = 5 paisa per rupee per month = 5 × 12 = 60% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (10,000 × 60 × 0.5) / 100

SI = (10,000 × 30) / 100

SI = 300,000 / 100

SI = 3,000

**The simple interest on Rs. 10,000 for 6 months is Rs. 3,000.**
